errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis has a linear scale. The values on the x-axis are 64, 128, 256, 512, and 768. The intervals between these points are not constant (64, 128, 256, 256), so the scale is not linear. The plot treats these as discrete categories placed at equal distances.
The description does not mention the presence of a legend box in the top-right corner of the chart. Although it is empty, it is still a component of the figure.
